title: Telekhines, the seal-dog smiths with Greek fire
prompt: A monster model sheet in the blocky voxel 3D style of a Minecraft-Dungeons-like game, isometric three-quarter views on a flat parchment-cream background, every part built from chunky cubes with hand-painted pixel textures. Telekhines: ancient sea-demon smiths, half dog and half seal, about the size of a large dog. Sleek grey-blue hide with darker speckles and a pale belly, a dog's head with a blunt seal snout, small fangs and glowing orange eyes, flippers for front feet, a stubby seal tail, a leather smith's apron and a brass harness carrying a clay pot of glowing green-orange Greek fire on its back. Show one telekhine front, side and back; then rearing up to hurl a fire pot in a high arc, the pot landing on a glowing ring marked on the ground, and the splash of green-orange flame; then a pack of three waddling on their flippers. Sly and mischievous rather than frightening. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
